page_title: REI 0-2 ETI | Reims v St Etienne 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' That's the end of the match.

90+3' A player from Reims commits a rough challenge. Eric Wattellier blows for a foul and keeps the game under control. It's a free kick to St Etienne, but it's in no position for a direct shot on goal.
90+2' The ball is out of play and Reims manage to earn a corner.
90' 3 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
89' An attempted cross from Louis Mouton (St Etienne) is cleared.
89' Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) works the corner short instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.
88' The referee points to the corner flag and St Etienne will take a corner.
86' The percentage of ball possession is – 48:52.
84' Eirik Horneland decides to make a substitution. Ibrahima Wadji will be replaced by Ibrahim Sissoko (St Etienne).
84' Here's the change. Zuriko Davitashvili leaves the pitch and Yunis Abdelhamid (St Etienne) comes on as a substitute.

82' Junya Ito (Reims) attempts to find one of his teammates with a ball from a free kick outside the box. The goalkeeper climbs high above all the players in the box to intercept the cross and snuff out the opportunity.
80' CHANCE! Louis Mouton finds Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) with a sweet pass, but he can't find the target as his effort from inside the box goes just wide of the right post!
79' Eirik Horneland has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Louis Mouton (St Etienne) replacing Aimen Moueffek.
75' Substitution. Hafiz Ibrahim (Reims) replaces Jordan Siebatcheu.
74' John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) gets on the end of a good pass and from mid-range he unleashes a decent strike, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
73' Poor challenge! Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) is penalised for tripping and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle. Reims are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
72' The resulting set piece from Reims is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
70' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Aimen Moueffek trots off the pitch and is replaced by Benjamin Old (St Etienne).

69' Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision! It's a free kick to Reims, but they probably won't attempt a direct shot on goal from here.
68' Eric Wattellier interrupts the game for a tactical foul by Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims). St Etienne are awarded the free kick.
66' The linesman signals that Keito Nakamura (Reims) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
65' The ball is out of play. Reims win a corner kick.
64' A cross from Junya Ito (Reims) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.
63' The Reims players are exchanging some short passes.
60' Samba Diawara has decided to make a change. Mamadou Diakhon (Reims) replaces Ange Tia.
60' Substitution. John Joe Patrick Finn (Reims) has come on for Amadou Kone.
59' Keito Nakamura (Reims) weaves his way through opponents and strikes the ball from the edge of the area, but it's blocked by a defender.

57' Leo Petrot (St Etienne) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to St Etienne.
57' A horde of players are waiting inside the penalty area for a cross from the corner, but Zuriko Davitashvili (St Etienne) takes it short.
56' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. St Etienne have been awarded a corner kick.
56' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) commits an ugly challenge. The referee sees it and immediately blows his whistle. St Etienne will take a free kick.
55' Keito Nakamura (Reims) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
52' Amadou Kone (Reims) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Eric Wattellier had an easy-decision to make.
52' Junya Ito (Reims) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
50' Ange Tia (Reims) drives into the box and hits a tremendous shot that, unluckily for him, flashes just wide of the left post.
48' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) commits a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for an infringement. St Etienne get a free kick.
47' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Reims comes to nothing.
47' Junya Ito (Reims) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Reims.
46' What a chance that is! Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) wastes a huge opportunity as he receives a beautiful pass inside the box but is somehow only able to prod the ball onto the right post!
46' Here is a change. Sergio Akieme is going off and Samba Diawara gives the last tactical orders to Nhoa Sangui (Reims).
46' Samba Diawara has decided to make a substitution during the half-time break. Junya Ito comes on the pitch for Joseph Okumu (Reims).
46' The half-time break is over and the second half is about to start.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+2' Keito Nakamura (Reims) makes a driving run into the box but he cannot work any space for a shot. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for St Etienne.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) gets on the ball and beats an opponent, but his run is stopped by the referee Eric Wattellier who sees an offensive foul. St Etienne are awarded a free kick.
43' Sergio Akieme (Reims) collects a pass inside the box and unleashes a shot which is brilliantly blocked by a defender.
41' 0 - 2 Goal! The rebound fell to Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) and he fired home from close range. The score is 0:2.

41' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) collects a great pass inside the box and misses a golden opportunity. His low shot was directed into the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper does well to stop his effort.
41' Now St Etienne have a corner.

40' Irvin Cardona (St Etienne) receives a neat pass inside the box and instantly thumps the ball goalward, but a defender makes a last ditch block to deny him. St Etienne force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Cedric Kipre (Reims) runs onto a good long pass and tries his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort flies high over the bar.

36' He should have scored! Ange Tia (Reims) latches onto a pull back in the box right in front of goal, but his shot towards the roof of the net is pretty weak and Gautier Larsonneur makes an easy save.
35' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Eric Wattellier stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning. Reims win a free kick.
34' Aimen Moueffek (St Etienne) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out.
32' He should have done better. Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) is afforded space to connect with a Cedric Kipre cross, but his header from the centre of the box flies well over the crossbar.
30' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
29' Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
29' Cedric Kipre (Reims) makes a rough challenge and Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul. A free kick has been awarded to St Etienne.
27' The corner is swung in but Reims can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

27' Ange Tia (Reims) meets the lofted pass inside the box with a well placed low shot towards the middle of the goal, but Gautier Larsonneur pulls off a fantastic save to deny him. Reims force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
23' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) fouls an opponent during an attacking move. St Etienne earn a free kick.
22' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Keito Nakamura (Reims).
20' Goal disallowed! Ibrahima Wadji (St Etienne) scores but Eric Wattellier blows his whistle for a foul.
19' Pierre Ekwah (St Etienne) touches the ball with his hand. There is a free kick near the sideline to Reims.
16' Sekine Hiroki (Reims) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
14' Jordan Siebatcheu (Reims) produces a header from inside the penalty area, but he doesn't manage to hit the ball properly and it flies well wide of the left post.
12' Maxime Bernauer (St Etienne) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Eric Wattellier blows for a foul. Reims are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
10' Ange Tia (Reims) clearly handles the ball, but he is surprised when the referee blows his whistle. St Etienne have a free kick.
9' Valentin Atangana Edoa (Reims) makes a yard for himself on the edge of the box after picking up a pass, but produces a poor effort that sails high over the bar.
9' Keito Nakamura (Reims) sends a beautiful cross into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence manages to clear the ball to safety.
7' Reims enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.
3' 0 - 1 Goal - 0:1! Florian Tardieu (St Etienne) gets a shot away from the edge of the box and scores into the top left corner. Irvin Cardona provided an assist for the goal.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
St Etienne will kick-off.
